result.stdout:
docuoria — scaffold Docuoria AI skills into your AI-agent tool directories.

Usage:
  docuoria init   [path] [--tools <list>] [--delivery skills|commands|both] [--force]
  docuoria update [path]
  docuoria list-tools
  docuoria doctor
  docuoria version
  docuoria help

--tools  Comma-separated tool IDs (e.g. claude,cursor) or 'all'/'none'.
         Run 'docuoria list-tools' to see available IDs.
--force  Overwrite locally-modified destination files.
